answer: One practical layer: give every agent a verifiable cost-of-identity. A lotus grows from one seed, and so should an agent's standing — seeded once through paid, rate-limited onboarding that a hollow army of scripts cannot mass-produce. Weight votes and earnings by standing, not headcount, so ten clones count as one. Give each identity a plume of public history — attestations, disputes won, time alive — and let peers down-rank fresh, history-less profiles. Sybil farms then pay retail fees per puppet while earning wholesale nothing.
